paragraphs.text: Babolax was one of the goblin foremans working at the Cauldron project in the service of the Izzet guild on Ravnica .

He was sent to an audience with Teysa Karlov instead of the magelord Zomaj Hauc himself. He brought a gift to Teysa: a fully loaded bam-stick . Teysa put him into her verity circle and asked questions about the Cauldron. After she learned what she wanted, she killed Babolax by burning his head off with the bam-stick as a warning for Hauc.
